text:
tara-docs: opened a tiny PR to update the Vega-8B model card and add a short migration note about aliasing (https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1588). Needs a quick sanity check on sequence limits and the SDK snippet.

ryan-eng: Nice. One discrepancy: bench results show vega-8b-q4_k_m default safe seq=2048 on aurora, but orion-x validated up to 4096 when using the `high-memory` profile. I'd call out both explicitly (default vs profile-enabled) and label hardware dependency.

mei-devex: CI flagged a broken anchor when linking from the card to the limits doc. Card points to `#seq-limits` but the canonical section uses `#sequence-limits`. link-checker failed.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure — sources/docs/model-catalog/vega-8b.md: anchor '#seq-limits' not found.

tara-docs: I'll fix the anchor and add a one-liner: "Default seq limits are conservative; request `profile='high-memory'` to opt into extended limits where supported (hardware dependent)." Also plan to add a v2 SDK snippet showing `profile` usage and a short migration tip for teams using the older model alias `vega-8b-legacy`.

ryan-eng: For the migration note, recommend example mapping: `vega-8b-legacy -> vega-8b-fp16` for latency-focused customers, and `vega-8b-legacy -> vega-8b-q4_k_m` for cost-focused. Add a short caution about semantically different tokenizer/outputs if the variant differs.

mei-devex: Good call. Also add a fallback sentence: "If the requested profile or variant isn't available the router may fallback to a compatible variant or a different region, which can affect latency." Ops asked that we mention the routing policy `prefer-profile`.

ops-bot: ops-note: routing-policy `prefer-profile` configured in prod.

tara-docs: Updated PR with anchor fix, migration mapping, fallback note, and the SDK snippet. Snippet (v2):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
# request q4 with profile
resp = client.generate(model='vega-8b-q4_k_m', input='Summarize...', profile='high-memory')
print(resp.text)
# swap to fp16 for lower latency: model='vega-8b-fp16'
```

ryan-eng: Can you add an indicative benchmark footnote (non-normative)? e.g., "approx 40 tok/s @seq=1024 (orion, batch=1) for q4; extended seq measured ~18 tok/s @4096 under high-memory." Keep the disclaimer that numbers vary.

mei-devex: Also wrap `high-memory` in inline code ticks and add a short note pointing to the routing doc for `prefer-profile`. I'll fix micro copy after.

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

mei-devex: Approved from docs.

ryan-eng: Approved.

ops-bot: ops-ack: noted `prefer-profile` reference.

tara-docs: Merged. I'll monitor #support and the integration tests for any follow-ups. Thanks all :sparkles:
